canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Us Bank, N.A. denied {value} of its 2,596 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Us Bank, N.A. decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Us Bank, N.A. will deny any specific future application with 23.5% probability
Us Bank, N.A. is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Us Bank, N.A. discriminates or violates law
23.5% applies to Us Bank, N.A.'s non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
